snippet.title: Chocolatier: Decadence by Design - Part 1 (No Commentary)
snippet.description: Chocolatier: Decadence by Design is a PC game that was released by Big Splash Games in 2009. This was one of my favorite PC games that I bought as a download from Big Splash Games back in 2009. You are able to actually buy and play this game today, as it is available on Steam!
